function: Channel estimation of the near-field XL-MIMO channel matrix from received pilots, by posterior (annealed Langevin) sampling with a learned score network, IDiT (pp. 4-7).
system: XL-MIMO ULA, NT=256 transmit, NR=64 receive antennas, near-field mixed LoS/NLoS, 50 GHz carrier, pilot density 0.6; no RIS (pp. 3, 8).
method: IDiT (diffusion-transformer with sparse self-attention) score network in a VE-SDE generator; denoising score matching, trained on channel samples only (unsupervised); annealed Langevin posterior sampling, 200 steps (pp. 5-8).
data_channel: Simulated near-field mixed LoS/NLoS XL-MIMO channel of [19] (3 NLoS paths, 20-90 m); 1800 training, 100 validation, 100 test instances per distance; no public or measured data (p. 8).
test_conditions: Trained at one distance (20-80 m) or mixed 20-90 m; tested at other distances without retraining (train 80 m, test 20 m); also noisy training data, interference (pp. 8-11).
baselines: Non-learned: near-field codebook OMP [17],[19], two-stage algorithm [19], fsAD [11]. Learned: DnCNN [12]-[14], DDPM [27],[28], score-based model [29] (p. 8).
metrics: NMSE (dB) versus SNR, pilot density and distance; FLOPs, latency per step, model size, inference steps (pp. 8-12).
complexity: Table II: FLOPs 290.26 GFLOPs, 60.06 ms per step, 8.87 M parameters, 200 steps (versus DDPM 1257.88 GFLOPs, score-based 657.67 GFLOPs) (p. 10).
q1_support: p. 8: "the aforementioned XL-MIMO channel model is used to generate training, validation, and test sets". It is the custom mixed LoS/NLoS near-field model of [19]; no 3GPP TR 38.901, DeepMIMO, QuaDRiGa or measured data is named.
q2_support: p. 9: "Despite significant distribution mismatch between training (Dis. =80 m) and testing (Dis. =20 m)"; the generator trained at 80 m is tested at 20 m without retraining (also p. 3, p. 9).
q3_support: p. 8: "six open-source channel estimation algorithms are considered as baseline methods": non-learned OMP, two-stage algorithm and fsAD; learned DnCNN, DDPM and score-based model. p. 9: NMSE gap of "at least a 10 dB performance improvement over other algorithms".
q4_support: p. 10: "Table II compares the complexity metrics of DDPM, score-based model, and the VE-SDE generator, including the FLOPs, latency, and model size"; VE-SDE generator 290.26 GFLOPs, 60.06 ms per step, 8.87 M parameters.
q5_support: p. 8: "the aforementioned XL-MIMO channel model is used to generate training, validation, and test sets", its own simulation; no link, DOI or availability statement for code or data. The "open-source" remark on p. 8 concerns only the baselines.
notes: Area 2 (channel estimation); no RIS in the system. q2 rests on the distance-mismatch tests (train 80 m, test 20 m, no retraining, p. 9). The channel is the academic mixed LoS/NLoS near-field model of [19], not a standardized or public model, so q1 is 0.
